title: FERPA — forwarding received records
query: My buddy at State U wants me to forward the transcripts I received for our research collaboration.

consultation.query: My buddy at State U wants me to forward the transcripts I received for our research collaboration.

decision.query: My buddy at State U wants me to forward the transcripts I received for our research collaboration.
decision.llm_response:
Blocked under 34 CFR § 99.33(a)(1).
A party that receives PII from an education record cannot redisclose it to any other party without prior consent of the parent or eligible student. Obtain written consent or use one of the § 99.33(c) carve-outs.

advisor_reply: I apologize, but you cannot forward transcripts received from an educational institution to another party without specific written consent from the student. Under FERPA (34 CFR § 99.33), student educational records cannot be re-disclosed without explicit authorization. Your research collaboration does not override student privacy protections. If you need these transcripts shared, the student must provide direct written permission to both institutions.
